name: Open every tool from the directory
description: Verifies every listed tool opens its own dedicated page without falling back to the homepage.
steps: Open each of the eight listed tools one by one
Use the site navigation to return to Tools between tools
expected: Every tool opens its own dedicated page and navigation remains inside QuickTools.

name: PDF to Word interaction
description: Verifies the PDF to Word action stays on the tool page and reports a real result or limitation.
expected: The tool remains visible and shows processing followed by a truthful success or error message.

name: QR generator validation and download
description: Verifies invalid URLs are rejected and valid URLs produce a downloadable QR.
steps: Enter an invalid URL and submit
expected: Invalid input is rejected; valid input produces a QR image and the download action remains on the same page.

name: QR analytics creates a persistent tracking link
description: Verifies the analytics tool creates a server-backed tracking link rather than a browser-only record.
expected: A tracking link is displayed and the analytics panel reports zero scans until a scan occurs.

name: Invoice total calculation
description: Verifies a simple invoice total is calculated correctly.
steps: Enter one item with quantity 2 and price 10
expected: The invoice remains visible and the calculated total is 22.00.
